name: Jan Veselý
bio: Jan's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent tinkering with engines alongside his grandfather, a former rally mechanic. This hands-on experience led him to pursue a degree in Mechanical Engineering, specializing in composite materials. After graduating, Jan honed his skills at a small racing outfit, fabricating bespoke components for Formula Ford cars. Now at Proton by Premotion, he brings a meticulous approach to his work, ensuring every part meets his exacting standards. He's driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible, constantly seeking innovative solutions to improve performance and reliability.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed hair with a slight wave.
physical.description: Jan is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing safety glasses perched on his forehead.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working on complex fabrications.
Insists on thoroughly inspecting every weld with a magnifying glass, even if it appears perfect.
